convention: AIJ Tominaga et al. (2008) / Blocken (2015) / Franke et al. (2007) / COST 732
purpose: Single source of truth for the MorphoFavela↔CFD contract: domain extent, blockage, and source-data eligibility for the 119-patch CFD campaign (22+22+25+25+25 across vidigal/riodaspedras/rocinha/complexo_do_alemao/maré). The CFD repo (Airflow runtime) consumes this manifest to size each patch's per-direction blockMesh, the MorphoFavela repo writes per_patch_indicators.csv consistent with it.

domain_extent.rule: Blocken 2015 §3.3 wide-obstacle: lateral scales with the larger of (5 H_max + R_patch) and 5 W_patch.
domain_extent.regime_note: For all 119 patches H_max < 90 m (campaign max H_max = 27.3 m at RDP-P15), so 5 W_patch = 500 m dominates the lateral. Lateral is therefore uniformly 500 m across the campaign, which makes blockage independent of H_max.

blockage.gate_source: Tominaga et al. (2008) AIJ guidelines for practical applications of CFD to pedestrian wind environment around buildings
blockage.frontal_area_note: Silhouette upper bound: treat the patch as a single solid block of dimensions D x H_max. AIJ benchmark convention for wide-cluster CFD. Real silhouette is at most this value (gaps between buildings can only reduce it).

alternative_estimators_reported.lambda_f_max: Per-direction sum-of-facades density via compute_frontal_area_ratio. Canopy-parameterisation quantity, not a CFD blockage gate. Routinely > 1.0 in dense favela patches; reported in audit_v1.csv for §4 morphometric tables only.
alternative_estimators_reported.lambda_p_patch: Footprint area in the 100 m disk / disk area. Replaces the 10 m grid-cell BCR in the per_patch_indicators.csv lambda_p column for blockage purposes.

source_data.envelope_geometry: Half-diagonal of the rotated rectangular box (20 H_max + 2 R_patch) long × (2 * lateral_m) wide, plus a 50 m additive safety margin. One radius covers all 8 wind directions.

deprecated_fields.name: blocken_radius_required
deprecated_fields.reason: Cylindrical-domain proxy. Replaced by source_data_required_m which uses the rectangular rotated-box diagonal.

campaign_eligibility_at_v1.n_eligible_target: 119/119 once all 5 sites have buffer ≥ 700 m
campaign_eligibility_at_v1.rationale: All failures are uniformly source-data-extent-only after the silhouette-envelope gate passes. A buffer extension lifts the entire campaign to 100% eligibility without dropping or replacing any patch. CDA / Maré / Rocinha each carry 25 patches per the original sampling allocation; Vidigal and Rio das Pedras carry 22.

references: Tominaga, Y., Mochida, A., Yoshie, R., Kataoka, H., Nozu, T., Yoshikawa, M., Shirasawa, T. (2008). AIJ guidelines for practical applications of CFD to pedestrian wind environment around buildings. Journal of Wind Engineering and Industrial Aerodynamics, 96(10-11), 1749-1761.
Franke, J., Hellsten, A., Schlünzen, K.H., Carissimo, B. (eds.) (2007). Best practice guideline for the CFD simulation of flows in the urban environment. COST Action 732, COST Office, Brussels.

Blocken, B. (2015). Computational Fluid Dynamics for urban physics: Importance, scales, possibilities, limitations and ten tips and tricks towards accurate and reliable simulations. Building and Environment, 91, 219-245.
